user.title: DrayTek Vigor
user.description: Enter the address of your DrayTek Vigor. SNMP (v2c) must be enabled on the device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Vigor, e.g. 192.168.1.1.
data_description.community: Read community configured on the Vigor (default: public).

interface.title: Select WAN interface
interface.description: Choose the interface that carries your DSL/WAN link. On DrayOS 5 (e.g. Vigor167) this is usually ptm0.

error.cannot_connect: No SNMP answer. Check address, community and that SNMP is enabled.
error.not_draytek: The device answered, but it does not look like a DrayTek.
error.no_interfaces: The device does not report any interfaces via SNMP.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.
